tasks.title: Verify production baseline
actions: Read current main and latest CI workflow with exact commit references.
Compare production/staging Worker BUILD_SHA, deployment percentage and active D1/R2 bindings.
Query applied migration ledgers and run read-only foreign-key integrity checks.
Record protected flags and secret names without exposing values.
tasks.acceptance: Signed technical baseline identifies exact source SHAs, migrations, deployments and runtime settings.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Signed baseline sheet; GitHub commit and CI links; Cloudflare deployment and D1 read-only results.

tasks.title: Reconcile F01-F20
actions: For each F-ID record source modules, API entry points, relevant UI routes and migrations.
Map corresponding unit, integration, browser and provider tests to exact SHAs.
Distinguish built source from authentic provider validation and operational acceptance.
Issue defects for absent or incomplete implementation.
tasks.acceptance: All 20 packages have explicit implemented, tested and accepted status supported by links.
tasks.retainedEvidence: F-ID traceability matrix; source/test links; gap list and reviewer dispositions.

tasks.title: Audit historical feature commitments
actions: Compare pre-integration branches, discussions and approved requirements to current main.
Review V4 catalogue, combined owner view, leasing administration, Open Home automation and tenant sectors.
Separate proposal-only ideas from approved commitments.
Record duplicates and migration lineage to prevent repeat work.
tasks.acceptance: Every previously approved capability is traced or expressly retained, deferred or superseded.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Historical feature matrix; approved source links; documented disposition proposals.

tasks.title: Approve scope and exclusions
actions: Publish a single retained-scope register with functional and non-functional requirements.
Decide full nine-portal scope versus a controlled limited launch.
Record exclusions with rationale, authoriser, impact and future review.
Freeze affected service, legal and financial assumptions before dependent activation.
tasks.acceptance: Versioned release scope formally separates mandatory features and approved exclusions.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Versioned release scope register; signed decision log; change-control history.

tasks.title: Map feature flags and environments
actions: Inventory Worker variables and protected feature switches separately for production and staging.
Associate each flag with routes, APIs, migrations, credentials and release checks.
Identify any read-only connectivity exceptions to otherwise disabled workflows.
Define guarded change, observation and OFF-switch rollback procedures.
tasks.acceptance: Every feature has environment, prerequisites, activation authority and rollback action.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Flag matrix; environment comparison; change/rollback instructions.

tasks.title: Establish task-level tracking
actions: Create one traceable issue per sprint task ID and relate it to the F01-F20 register.
Add blockers, linked branches/PRs, reviewer and acceptance fields.
Avoid duplicates with existing issues and preserve historical discussions.
Define closure checks and a recurring backlog review cadence.
tasks.acceptance: Every task has owner, priority, dependencies, acceptance evidence and tracking location.
tasks.retainedEvidence: GitHub issue index; master Issue #54 links; closure rules and issue template.

tasks.title: Approve acceptance governance
actions: Nominate Product, Engineering, QA, Finance, Legal/Privacy, Security, Operations and independent Release approvers.
Record authority and alternates for absences.
Separate developer implementation from independent acceptance.
Require sign-off timestamps, source SHA and evidence links per release gate.
tasks.acceptance: Named independent owners and reviewers are recorded for all critical approvals.
tasks.retainedEvidence: RACI and named signatory register; decision-rights matrix; approved release gate owners.

tasks.title: Finalise the service catalogue
actions: Review all 23 current public services and classify available versus requested-by-quote.
Approve deliverables, property sectors, scope limits and report outputs for each.
Document which historical V4 references are not customer-facing services.
Lock revision identifiers for marketing and operational mapping.
tasks.acceptance: Versioned 23-service catalogue approved with consistent inclusions, exclusions and eligibility.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Approved service register; scope cards; catalogue version/hash.

tasks.title: Map services to commercial products
actions: Trace service IDs to approved sale variants, Stripe products/prices and work-order templates.
Prevent inactive/reference SKUs from being offered accidentally.
Define exception handling for bespoke quotes and included entitlements.
Add fixture tests covering all published services.
tasks.acceptance: Every sold or included service has an unambiguous service, SKU and Work Order/report mapping.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Service-to-SKU-to-template matrix; test results for missing/duplicate mappings.

tasks.title: Approve service prices
actions: Approve published price versus quotation-required designation.
Specify GST-inclusive/exclusive display, surcharges, add-ons and discount precision.
Cross-check Stripe calculation against ProInspect integer-cent amounts.
Version pricing with effective dates and changes policy.
tasks.acceptance: Single authorised AUD/GST price matrix reconciles quote, booking, Checkout and invoice.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Signed fee schedule; GST cases; customer-facing price screenshots.

tasks.title: Approve scheduling and geographic rules
actions: Publish eligible suburbs/postcodes, property types, capacity and roster rules.
Specify appointment durations, access/travel buffers and notice periods.
Test conflicts, unavailable slots, cross-sector requests and cancellation windows.
Align Calendar availability and operator overrides with published booking rules.
tasks.acceptance: Eligible services can be reserved; invalid locations, capacity and times are rejected consistently.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Service-area table; scheduler cases; conflict and rejection logs.

tasks.title: Resolve subscription-policy conflicts
actions: Compare legacy automatic all-inclusive accounts with proposed paid property subscriptions.
Preserve current customer rights unless a formally approved transition applies.
Determine who is billed and which services consume allowances.
Record upgrade, downgrade, pause and dispute behaviour.
tasks.acceptance: One authoritative policy defines included entitlements, paid additions and renewal rules.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Approved entitlement policy; existing-account impact assessment; regression fixtures.

tasks.title: Resolve inspection frequencies and transitions
actions: Identify every frequency statement in legal, marketing, code and subscriptions.
Approve annual service allowance, replenishment and exceptional use rules.
Define treatment of existing customers and grandfathered plans.
Test transitions across renewal, cancellation and allowance exhaustion.
tasks.acceptance: Quarterly versus twice-yearly and unlimited allowances resolved without unapproved changes to existing entitlements.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Frequency decision; migration/transition plan; before-after entitlement tests.

tasks.title: Approve PCR launch offer

Review four 20% routine-inspection benefits and purchaser/property binding.
Approve refund restoration, cancellation and 48-hour delivery claims.
Keep launch and sample-publication flags OFF until authorised.

tasks.title: Revalidate booking journeys

tasks.title: Reconcile customer-facing information

Capture current configuration and deny evidence.

tasks.title: Accept Strata Manager portal

Run common-property inspection, asset maintenance, proposal and Work Order.
Verify notice/report audiences and billing distinctions.
Attempt cross-scheme lookups and approvals.
tasks.acceptance: Scheme operations respect scheme boundaries and financial approval limits.

tasks.title: Accept Tenant portal

Submit maintenance/evidence, view published PCR and respond.
Access only issued documents, then end tenancy.
Test post-end restrictions and restricted Form 2 isolation.
tasks.acceptance: Tenant can perform permitted actions and cannot act beyond tenancy or access restrictions.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Tenant journey and uploaded evidence; PCR response audit; denied links.

tasks.title: Accept Building/Resident portal

Submit building requests and view targeted notices.
Exercise move/access interactions where retained.
Attempt viewing other lot, council or private notes.

tasks.title: Accept Strata Council portal
actions: Verify dated council membership and conflict disclosure.
Review operational proposal, notices and permitted recommendations.
Test council-term expiry and revoked appointment.
Confirm recommendation does not create statutory resolution or pay authority.
tasks.acceptance: Council can review appropriate material without gaining unapproved statutory powers.
tasks.retainedEvidence: Council log; governance-limit tests; term-revocation evidence.

tasks.title: Accept Staff/Admin portal
actions: Assign inspectors, operate scheduler, Work Orders, reports and document issue.
Exercise approved billing and legal review interfaces.
Test restricted evidence, segregation of duties and failed attempts.
Validate operational queues and errors can be investigated.
tasks.acceptance: Staff perform permitted work and privileged/restricted operations remain auditable.

tasks.title: Accept professional Building Manager portal

Manage delegated facilities, access devices, moves and Work Orders.
Test private summary and access instructions controls.
Revoke assignment and verify immediate denial.

tasks.title: Run cross-portal permissions

Test ID guessing, direct API requests and document grants across accounts.

Review authorisation logs for explicit deny reasons.

Review deviations, unresolved bugs, explicit deferrals and security findings.

Prevent broad activation when dependent experience is incomplete.

tasks.title: Complete multi-scheme strata acceptance

rehearse on restored/representative staging data.
